title: Pale Ford Arch
description: A 25-metre barrel vault with a 3.7-metre freestanding slab deck, flared abutments and alternating open and solid limestone parapets.

review.notes: Round 3 (final), closest to passing. Fixed: the parapet now varies, with heavier posts, newel posts at the ends and a carved crown panel; the stairs meet stepped abutments; a weathered band now sits at the abutment base. Not fixed: (1) apart from that thin base band the stone is still uniformly clean ivory; joints, the underside of the coping and the arch intrados show no localized weathering, and no balusters are chipped or broken (round-2 points 1-2). (2) The front landing is still loose thin slabs lying on the ground with gaps, not tied into the abutment and wing walls (round-2 point 3). (3) hero.jpg frames the bridge tiny in the middle of the image, so the hero view cannot show the detail; frame it to fill the shot.
